title: High school protests spread across France, pitting radical left against government
subhead: The protest movement expanded beyond the Paris region on Monday, affecting 180 schools nationwide. The interior minister described incidents as 'urban violence' that led to 164 arrests. The government accused La France Insoumise of exploiting the protests, while its leader Jean-Luc Mélenchon denounced 'irresponsible repression.'
